request.task: T3B closure for Local teammate presentation, strict receipt adapter, data safety, and submit state machine
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied. The slice’s oracles are renderToStaticMarkup plus adapter/unit checks: they pin static Idle roster copy, placeholder/no-provider disclosure, data-class help linkage, working submit as natively enabled + aria-disabled, exact five-key envelope rejection for missing/extra/non-null terminal variants, and bound complete vs terminal receipt rules. They do not execute the form/click path, so F-08 focus and duplicate-submit proof is not in this allowlist (criterion assigns that to live browser E2E). Untested but implemented branches include a fully valid six-key proposal with a non-complete receipt, extra keys on a complete envelope, and complete+null proposal; those currently fall through to error in submitAiTeammateAssignment.
residual_risks: AiTeammateRunReceiptV1Schema is outside the slice; if it is non-strict or a wide status enum, extra receipt fields or odd non-complete statuses could still parse as bound.
PreviewSelection is display-only and omitted from the POST body; truthful canvas copy depends on the parent actually passing selection.
Idle-valid markup tests assert native disabled absence, not aria-disabled absence; current code omits aria-disabled when not working.
